$comment: Defaults every listensmith tool and the scrobbler share, each settable in that tool's config file outside every checkout. Ports: ruling S4 (I6). Feed timings: rulings C3 (heartbeat while playing) and C4 (silence before the feed is stale). max_listen_size is not a setting: it is ListenBrainz's per-listen limit in bytes as pinned (I2), which every side of the contract reads from here.
